newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador names U.N. official Ayala foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador names U.N. official Ayala foreign minister.

text.p: The new Ecuadorean government has named U.N. Human Rights High Commissioner Jose Ayala as its foreign minister, a senior official said.
"I am happy to confirm that ambassador Jose Ayala has accepted the ministry," deputy foreign minister Diego Ribadeneira told reporters late on Wednesday.

Government officials said Ayala's top priority would be to lead negotiations to end a border dispute with Peru, over which the two nations went to war briefly in early 1995. Ayala has been Ecuador's ambassador to Peru.
Ecuador is recovering from a political crisis following this month's ouster of populist Abdala Bucaram as president.

Congress last week voted to install Fabian Alarcon as interim president until Aug. 10, 1998, when a new democratically elected head of state will take over following general elections early next year.
Alarcon has already named several other cabinet ministers.
